name: Sharika Enterprises Limited
about: Sharika Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiary, engages in the engineering procurement construction (EPC) contracts, specialized assembling, trading, and erection and representation services businesses in India. The company offers smart MV switchgear, including VCB panels, auto source changeover, kiosk type VCBs, automatic circuit reclosers, sectionalizers, and smart fault isolation device; fault passage indicators, application specific FRTUs, RMU / LBS monitoring and control, distribution transformer monitoring, and software as a service; substation automation products, such as C and R Panels IEC 61850, RTU panels, and IEC 61850 based gateways; and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), and advanced distribution management system software products, as well as cast resin distribution transformers. It also provides grid-connected solar PV systems, hybrid and off-grid solutions with battery storage, EV charging integration enabled microgrids, smart solar street lights, real-time remote monitoring and analytics, and rooftop, ground-mounted and institutional projects; wind farm SCADA and monitoring; transmission solutions, comprising EHV cables, substation automation, SCADA integration, and smart communication infrastructure; and feeder automation, unmanned substations, energy monitoring, and smart communication infrastructure. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of engineering services; design, procurement, and execution of EPC project; manufacture of protection, control, and power distribution panels; SCADA and automation integration; EPC and integration services for solar power, hybrid systems, EV-ready infrastructure; and digital enablement and training. Further, it engages in management consultancy and project execution services businesses; and trade of electrical items, including LED lights and other related products and components. Sharika Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
